speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry (a) whether the Government envisions a larger role for Singapore in realising the ASEAN Power Grid; and (b) whether the Government is considering direct investments in renewable and sustainable cross-border electricity infrastructure to ensure electricity sustainability.

speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Power Grid is ASEAN's vision to integrate the national power systems of its 10 member states.

speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: This will create opportunities for mutual support and electricity trading among the member states.

speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: The ASEAN Power Grid can facilitate ASEAN's decarbonisation efforts.

speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: There is significant renewable energy potential in the Southeast Asia region.

speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
text: Building energy interconnections can help to realise this potential by joining the producing regions to the consumption points or regions.
